question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Consent
solution:
The correct answer is "**Assent.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• "**Assent**" means to agree to or approve of something.(अनुमति)
 
 
• ​Example: The act was given the royal assent.
 
 
 
• "**Consent"** means to give permission or approval.(सहमति)
 
 
• ​Example: The parents refused to consent to the marriage.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, it can be concluded that the word "assent" is a synonym of "consent."

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Avert**" means to prevent or avoid something.(टालना)
 
• "**Disturb**" means to interrupt or unsettle someone or something.(परेशान करना)
 
• "**Dissent**" means to disagree with or oppose something.(मतभेद)
